categories.main_business_segments: Guotai Epoint Software Co., Ltd. focuses on three primary business segments: Smart Procurement, Smart Government Affairs, and Digital Construction. The company provides intelligent software platforms, hardware devices, and comprehensive digital solutions including platform operation, maintenance, and intelligent engineering services to government departments, large enterprises, and related industries across China.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as AI and large models, big data analytics, cloud computing, blockchain, IoT, BIM, CIM, and low-code development platforms. It employs platform-based, componentized, collaborative, and integrated software development methodologies, supported by a scientific Integrated Product Development (IPD) process. Key proprietary technologies include secure multi-CA digital certificate management, high-concurrency electronic bidding decryption, blockchain-based trusted procurement, intelligent evaluation systems, and industry-specific large models.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include government agencies at various levels, central and large state-owned enterprises, other large enterprises, public resource trading centers, bidding agencies, construction and engineering firms, consulting institutions, and individual users in the construction sector. The company serves markets nationwide across China, excluding Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan, with a focus on digital transformation in procurement, government services, and construction industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, covering all 31 provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions except Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan. It has established five regional headquarters in Hefei, Shenyang, Zhengzhou, Changsha, and Chongqing; two resource centers in Suzhou and Chengdu; and 23 regional branches in major cities including Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, and Hangzhou, ensuring comprehensive national coverage.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guotai Epoint Software operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the digital economy supply chain, focusing on software development, platform operation, and service delivery. It provides end-to-end digital solutions and services that support procurement processes, government digitalization, and construction industry digital transformation, rather than upstream hardware manufacturing or raw material supply.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in AI large models, big data, cloud-native architectures, low-code platforms, intelligent interaction, and domestic BIM technologies. It emphasizes integrating AI and data-driven capabilities into its core business segments to enhance intelligent procurement, government digital services, and digital construction. R&D efforts include developing industry-specific large models, intelligent agent platforms, and upgrading software frameworks to support rapid deployment and scalability.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through software product sales, SaaS platform subscriptions, operation and maintenance service fees, intelligent hardware sales, and intelligent engineering project revenues. The company also earns income from platform operation services by charging usage fees to bidding and procurement participants, and from maintenance contracts with government and enterprise clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Guotai Epoint Software holds a leading position in the smart procurement market, especially on the government side, and is a major player in smart government and digital construction sectors. It competes with large software companies like Inspur and Digital Government Tong, and specialized construction software providers such as Glodon. The company leverages its extensive industry experience, technical innovation, and comprehensive service capabilities to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.15 billion, a 12.08% decrease from the previous year, with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 204 million, up 4.88%. It employs over 6,200 staff, including more than 2,100 R&D personnel, and maintains a strong R&D investment ratio exceeding 21% of revenue. The company has demonstrated steady profitability and cash flow growth, with a focus on sustainable development and operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through deep integration of AI large models and big data into its software platforms, enabling intelligent procurement, government digitalization, and construction management. It offers comprehensive, customizable digital solutions combining software, hardware, and services, supported by a robust R&D system and extensive industry expertise. Its commitment to innovation, high-quality project delivery, and customer-centric service fosters strong client loyalty and market leadership.
